name: legacy-relight-preview
description: Quick relight of a compiled legacy map for checking the whole chain (tools/quality/legacy_bsp_relight.py --quality legacy-relight-preview): the legacy-relight outputs at preview cost: a 2048 atlas at 256 samples with Blender's default light paths, a PRBV at 4 m, radiosity patches of 2 m and SDFV voxels of 0.5 m. Not for judging light quality; the SDFV's light cells are 2 m, culled by range (0.001), side and the map's PVS. Since 2026-09-30 the radiosity transfer (RTRN), the SDF volume (SDFV) and the reflection probes' relight bands are not baked: moving-light GI is out of scope (user decision), so the indirect light is the bake's and those data served only RFC 0011's opt-in producers.
